title: Creamy scrambled eggs
summary: Quick, cheap and easy to overcook: perfect for a demo.
source: Starter outline written by Claude. Matthew: replace/compare with a TheMealDB import, then hand-check.

steps.instruction: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk until smooth.
looks_right: even yellow colour, no streaks of white
looks_wrong: bits of shell in the bowl

steps.instruction: Melt the butter in a non-stick pan on LOW heat.
looks_wrong: butter browning or smoking (heat too high)

steps.instruction: Pour in the eggs and stir slowly and constantly with a spatula.
looks_wrong: eggs setting instantly at the edges (too hot)
steps.done_when: Curds forming but still a bit wet.

steps.instruction: Take the pan off the heat while still slightly runny. Season and serve on toast.
looks_wrong: water leaking out of the eggs
steps.done_when: Off the heat while glossy. They keep cooking in the pan.
